audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].side read "Skill" while win[4..6] read "Anivia" — three rows where the page gives two answers.
audit.why: Glacial Storm at 6 is the documented flip and both the packet chart and the content layer put every post-6 row on Anivia. Pantheon's R is 180s at rank 1 and his kit falls off; Anivia is at 50.76% over 924 games precisely because she owns the back half.

Pantheon's spike is levels 1-5 with Comet Spear (25 mana) and Shield Vault; Grand Starfall at 6 is 180s at rank 1 and is a map tool, not a lane one. Anivia's ladder — Lost Chapter, level 6, Seraph's/RoA — is stated correctly.
audit.corrected: Added the 180s figure and the 22s Aegis Assault window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most valuable interaction in this matchup is absent: Aegis Assault (E) is a channel and Flash Frost's stun cancels it outright. Nothing mentions that he is invulnerable to damage from the front while it holds, and Shield Vault is called his "sidestep tool" when it is a 600-range dash-stun with an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's text: Pantheon "sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly", and the kit flags it channel (interruptible), untargetable and shield. On 22s at rank 1 it is his longest cooldown, so cancelling it is the whole punish window. Crystallize is terrain and denies Shield Vault's dash.
audit.corrected: Wrote the Q-cancels-the-channel rule, the front-facing invulnerability, and the wall-versus-dash line.

audit.why: Shield Vault 13s at rank 1, Comet Spear 11s for 25 mana, Aegis Assault 22s, Grand Starfall 180s — none of these numbers appear anywhere in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0] both name a Pantheon ability called "Spear Shot".
audit.why: There is no such ability. His Q is Comet Spear; the same line then also says "Comet Spear crit", so the text names one ability twice under two names.

notes: "Spear Shot" is a fabricated ability name and appeared twice in the content layer; Pantheon's Q is Comet Spear — both fixed. The packet's suspectNames entry ("Glacial Storm's" flagged at distance 2 from "glacial storm") is a false positive: that is Anivia's own R in a possessive, correctly spelled. Highest-value addition is Aegis Assault being an interruptible channel that Flash Frost cancels — it was absent from every field. I did not assert whether Anivia's Frostbite or Glacial Storm damage bypasses the front-facing invulnerability from behind; Riot's text says invulnerable from the front but the kit does not confirm the rear angle, so I left that out.
